text:
Alex Kim: Hey team — need a small deliverable set for next Wed's webinar and the inbound play. TL;DR: 1 hero diagram (lead routing + fallbacks), 3 benchmark microtiles (latency / cost / uptime), and a 2-slide template (speaker + CTA). Can design take this? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maria Gomez: @Alex Kim yep we can. Do you have copy for the tiles and the routing steps? Also what's the priority on brand-safe color variants vs quick turnaround?
Alex Kim: Priority is speed but must pass brand check. Copy below (feel free to tighten):
- Tile A: "Low-latency serving at scale"
- Tile B: "Optimize inference $/token"
- Tile C: "95% P99 under SLA"
- Routing steps (for hero diagram): Ingress -> Smart routing (latency/cost) -> Model variants -> Cache / Fallback -> Client
Samir Patel: Copy edits: Tile A: "Predictable low latency"; Tile C: "P99 within SLA (95% of requests)". For the hero, can we show two fallback lanes (model downgrade, cross-region)?
Designbot: Available. ETA initial mockups: 48 hours for tiles, 72 hours for hero diagram + slide template. Need exact sizes and file naming. Also request a figma frame with components.
Alex Kim: Size guide:
```
Tiles: 1200x1200 px (square) export @2x PNG + SVG
Hero diagram: 1920x1080 px + 1280x720 for slides
Slides: 16:9 keynote/figma frames with editable layers
Naming: webinar2025_tile_latency_v1.png, webinar2025_hero_v1.svg, webinar2025_slide_deck_v1.fig
```
Maria Gomez: Legal check — @Lisa Park can you confirm we can use the latency benchmark language? We referenced P99 and $/token, nothing customer-specific.
Lisa Park: Quick pass: that language is fine. Avoid referencing competitor names. We'll want to run accessibility color contrast on the three tile variants before final export.
Designbot: Noted. I'll include 3 color variants: brand-primary, brand-alt-dark, and high-contrast. I'll add alt text suggestions and export presets.
Samir Patel: For the slide CTA copy please use: "See how Redwood reduces inference costs — sign up for the webinar". Also add a compact speaker bio slide (60 words).
Alex Kim: Great. One more ask: include a small schematic for inbound lead routing (where form -> marketing automation -> SDR queue -> demo link). Keep it generic.
Designbot: Adding schematic to hero file as a separate layer so product can reuse.
Maria Gomez: I'll queue this in the launch lane and tag for production once designs are approved. Estimated publish assets: social card, webinar landing hero, slide deck.
Lisa Park: I'll do a fast brand sweep once mockups are in Figma. @Designbot pls tag me in the file.
Designbot: Will do.
Alex Kim: Thanks all — please post figma link when first pass is ready. :pray:
